# Awarse Labs Documentation

> Local-first AI developer tools for FinOps and Playwright QA automation built on FastMCP.

## Core Documentation Guides
- [Playwright Self-Healing Locators](https://awarselabs.com/docs/healwright/playwright-self-healing-locators): Technical guide on preventing CI flakiness and repairing broken selectors using Healwright and FastMCP.
- [SeatPrune Quickstart: Automated SaaS Seat Reclamation](https://awarselabs.com/docs/seatprune/quickstart): Setup and configuration guide for running local-first FinOps audits to identify and reclaim inactive seats across GitHub, Slack, and Jira.

## Repositories & Tools
- awarse-mcp: https://github.com/awarselabs/awarse-mcp
- healwright (PyPI): https://pypi.org/project/healwright/
- seatprune (PyPI): https://pypi.org/project/seatprune/

## Architecture Highlights
- Local-first execution (no user directory data egress).
- Zero-overhead ephemeral FastMCP servers.
- Deterministic dry-run safety modes.
